Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:For): one use and up to three articles, listed as A, A and B, or A, B, and C, or the board's disambiguation page when no article is given; shown in italics instead of the hatnote style, since the wiki allows no <div>; &#32; before "and", since #if trims a plain space there; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{For|the forum software|PhpBB}}
Example: {{For|the installer|Installation|Upgrading}}
Example: {{For|other things|A|B|C}}
